definitions.full: H6766. Tseltsach צֶלְצַח proper name, of a location in Benjamin 1Sam 10:2 (si vera 1.; probably corrupt (Dr); HPS conjectures מִצֵּלַע , compare 2Sam 21:14 ). I, II. [ צִלְצָל ], צֶלְצְלִים צְלָצַ֑ל, see I. צלל .

occurrences.englishText: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. They will tell you, ‘The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys, and is anxious for you, saying, “What shall I do for my son?” ’
